title: Aesthetic Treatments at AnyLopez Clinic — Benidorm
description: Eight specialities, one craft. Editorial catalogue of facial, body, injectable and apparatology treatments at AnyLopez Aesthetic Clinic, Benidorm.

hero.lead_html: Three generations designing, delivering and overseeing every treatment. We don't hire trainees or rush back-to-back sessions to fit a tight schedule — when you book, you're seen by the person who signs off the result.

trust.sub: More than 30 years caring for patients in Benidorm

flagship.h2_html: INDIBA Radiofrequency — the lifting effect that doesn't show.
flagship.p_html: If you've cared for your skin all your life but the mirror keeps showing laxity, INDIBA Radiofrequency is the answer without surgery. CRet/RES technology that stimulates your own collagen from the very first session. Painless, no recovery time, compatible with every other treatment.

finalCta.h2_html: Book a free assessment and we'll tell you what you need — and what you don't.
finalCta.p_html: Thirty minutes, no commitment. If it's not for you, we'll say so straight up and point you in the right direction. Honesty before the basket.
